subject: Unexpected append-only ingest charges during July closeout
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Charge spike — July append-only ingestion

Hi Ben,

We noticed a ~4.1x increase in our July usage line compared to June (see attached snapshot). We ingest append-only audit logs into an embeddings index; we did not change retention or traffic patterns. The invoice shows a big jump on tokenized embeddings usage and VAT applied on the higher amount. Can you explain what caused this spike and whether any of this is eligible for a credit?

Quick asks:
- Line-level breakdown by token class and API (embedding vs generate) for 2027-07-01 -> 2027-07-31
- Any known rollout or counting changes in July that might affect append-only workloads
- Temporary invoice hold or provisional credit while we investigate VAT exposure

Appreciate quick help — finance needs to close the month.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Patel
Sr. Finance Ops, Acme Health
attachments: acme_usage_snapshot_20270731.csv (text/csv)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge spike — July append-only ingestion

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. I'm sorry for the surprise, and I want to get you a concrete breakdown today. Short answer up front: we saw an ingest-side token amplification affecting a subset of append-only flows on our embeddings pipeline during the July 9–12 deploy window. We're still validating root cause and impact scope.

What I'm doing now:
- Looping in Marissa (billing ops) and Grace (customer success) to pull line-item CSVs and VAT treatment notes.
- Requesting telemetry exports for your tenant for July 1–31 (per-route, per-model token counts).
- Provisionally flagging the invoice for review — we can hold collection on invoice 20270731 while we investigate (pending AP approval).

Can you confirm whether Acme Health ran any bulk backfills, re-index jobs, or changed the client-side tokenizer between July 1–15? That will help narrow whether the amplification was client- or server-side.

I'll follow up with the export and an initial token-class breakdown by EOD.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge spike — July append-only ingestion

Ben / Grace — I pulled the invoice lines and the raw token export for acct 1104. Initial read shows two unusual signals: (1) a burst of short, repetitive requests that expanded with a different tokenization boundary (we think a tokenizer upgrade in our embeddings preproc triggered new split points), and (2) a higher VAT base because the grossed-up token count passed a threshold for a different tax bucket in their EU subsidiary mapping (their tenant has linked EU orgs).

Attached I'll drop an extract to share with Samira — it has per-route token counts, model used (embed-large-v2, hybrid-embed-quant), and a sampled request trace.

Recommendation while root cause is confirmed:
- Offer a provisional credit for the excess over a 3x baseline for July (negotiable)
- Issue a corrected line-item export and VAT recalculation if we find counting change on our side
- Hold collection for 7 days to let Samira's AP team confirm

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_invoice_20270731.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Samira Patel <samira.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@acmehealth.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge spike — July append-only ingestion

Thanks Ben and Marissa — appreciate the quick triage. We did run a reindex job on July 10 to add a new metadata key across historical events (backfill), which may have re-hit the ingestion pipeline, but our instrumentation showed steady per-event sizes. We did not change any tokenizer configuration client-side.

If the amplification is on Redwood's tokenizer boundary adjustments, we'd expect some over-counting for the backfill window only (July 10–13). Two asks from our side:
1) If you confirm server-side counting change, please provide the corrected per-day token totals and a proposed provisional credit amount; we prefer a credit rather than invoice reversal for month-end close.
2) Clarify VAT exposure: if the over-count inflates the VAT base for linked EU subsidiaries, what is Redwood's approach to retroactively recalculating VAT?

If you can hold collection, AP will pause payment pending your proposal — I copied billing@acmehealth.com.

—Samira
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Samira Patel <samira.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, finance-collections@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Charge spike — July append-only ingestion

Samira — update after internal review:

Summary:
- Root cause: a tokenizer boundary change in our embeddings preprocessor was unintentionally enabled behind a feature flag during the July 9 deploy. That change increased token splits on certain multi-line audit events; the effect amplified during your July 10 backfill window.
- Impact window: 2027-07-09 18:00 -> 2027-07-13 02:30 UTC.
- Scope for Acme (acct 1104): ~62% of the excess tokens fall inside the backfill window.

Proposed remediation:
1) We will issue a provisional credit equal to the billed excess tokens above a 3x baseline for July 10–13 (calculation summary attached).
2) We will recalculate VAT on the adjusted invoice and issue a corrected VAT line. If a refund of VAT is required by local rules, we'll work with Acme's finance team and provide the supporting audit trail; otherwise we will issue a tax-adjusted credit.
3) Collection hold: Redwood will mark invoice 20270731 as under review; please pause payment for 7 business days while we finalize numbers.

Next steps (for transparency):
- Marissa to send the per-day corrected token totals and the provisional credit amount by EOD tomorrow.
- Grace will set up a short call with Samira and Acme AP if needed to confirm VAT routing.

We're sorry for the disruption — this is on us and we'll get the corrected documentation to you quickly.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Exec — Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
